:::{#exm-exp-above-tangent}
#### Two values of the bounds

<!-- no-figure: the example is two numbers -->

At $x = 1$, $\expf{1} = \euler \approx 2.718$,
which is at least $1 + 1 = 2$.
At $t = 2$, $\logf{2} \approx 0.693$,
which is at most $2 - 1 = 1$.
Neither is an equality,
because $x \ne 0$ and $t \ne 1$.

:::
